closed: Advanced statistics are not open yet.
none: No statistics have been computed for this team yet.
nonePlayer: No statistics have been computed for this player yet.
stale: The nightly computation is late: these figures may be yesterday's.

missing.sin_cobertura: Its league does not record it often enough

leagueMark: The grey mark is the league's median
xgSub: For and against, oldest to newest
statesSub: From the goals minute by minute · {n} matches
pulseSub: Goals per minute, smoothed · the band shows the uncertainty
pulseNote: Goals with a minute only · history, not live momentum
pulseMethod: Goals per minute in smoothed 5' bins, divided by the league's at the same minute (100 = league); 45+' and 90+' are bins of their own; the band shows how much the figure would change with other matches.
intervalsSub: For above · against below · the grey mark is the league's mean
survivalTitle: How long until the match opens?
survivalSub: Probability the score is still 0-0 at minute t
survivalNone: No median: more than half of its matches never open
trendsSub: Historical frequencies with their sample. The colour marks the deviation from the league, not a recommendation.
streaksSub: The light span is the 95 % Wilson interval: with small samples almost anything is possible
radarSub: Always the same order; the polygon's area means nothing
radarSame: Radar and bars show the same figures: pick the shape you prefer
radarFormula: Attack = xG for per match · Finishing = goals − xG · Volume = shots per match · Presence = corners for − against · Defence = 100 − percentile of xG against · Discipline = 100 − percentile of cards
distSub: The shade is the position's distribution; the dot, him · {nineties} nineties
distCompare: Two dots on the same distribution
distCompareSub: The shade is the league ({position}, per 90): it shows whether a difference is large or noise
templateNote: Each position has its template: goalkeepers (saves, save %), defenders (duels, interceptions), midfielders (passes, recoveries), forwards (goals, shots)
playerNote: History and rates per 90, not probability · no single score or «rating»
scatterSub: Each grey dot is a league {position} (≥5 nineties)
previewSub: {home} at home and {away} away · each against its league
previewNone: No statistics have been computed for these teams yet.
previewTrendsNote: Frequencies with their sample · the full matrix lives in the team's profile

stateNote.en_calibracion: The model exists but has not passed its calibration yet: meanwhile, odds and history
stateNote.necesita_datos: No model of our own: odds and history
stateNote.no_ofrecer: No settlement rule of our own: only the price is shown

methodBody: PrediGol: on checked markets only, with its seal and time. Bookmakers: what the current prices of the bookmakers say, without their margin (mean over bookmakers). History: the selection settled with its rule over the home side's last 10 at home and the away side's last 10 away, with its Wilson interval. No arbitrary gauges. On refundable lines (a whole line, draw no bet, a whole handicap) the model's figure is the chance of winning if not refunded, like the implied one and the history; on quarter lines none is shown.
distribution: The model's distribution of the total
